name: Dead Flower Equestria
source:
Set during Season 3 of My Little Pony, you return from a failed adventure in the sisters' castle – only to face grim news. What would you risk to save your friends?

[From [url=https://atomickotik.itch.io/deadflowerequestria]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在《彩虹小馬：友情就是魔法》第三季期間。你在雙公主城堡裡的一次冒險以失敗告終，回去後卻又遇上噩耗。為了拯救朋友，你肯拿什麼去冒險？
